    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]

    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in cells), max(c for _, c in cells) + 1
    h, w = r1 - r0, c1 - c0
    return [grid[r0 + r][c0:c0 + w // 2] for r in range(h // 2)]
